plan.rate_basis: development pilot serial-active median stage estimate; not measured sustainable capacity
plan.selection: lowest success p95 at fixed 30 requests/s development pilot among candidates
plan.acceptance: nominal (lowest-rate) median p95 improves at least 5%, candidate repeat p95 range lies below baseline range, success/offered does not fall by >0.5pp; neither nominal condition has generator drops or p95 send lag above its arrival interval
plan.quality: same FP32 graph/input contract; no quality-driven thread tuning

environment.load_generator: same-host loopback httpx asyncio; shares CPU budget

timing_boundaries.client: immediately before httpx post to complete response receipt; loopback transport included
timing_boundaries.server: handler entry through JSON response body construction; excludes framework dispatch before handler, timing-header construction, ASGI send and network
timing_boundaries.executor_wait: same-process perf_counter_ns from dispatch enqueue to worker entry; explicit observed wait
timing_boundaries.model: ready numpy float32 tensor through completed ORT CPU output
